svg.text: Original artwork for a reversible scarf · Tafi-inspired proportions · first design study
Paired floral paisleys · continuous vine border · quiet ground
Target 141 × 62.5 cm. Planning grid: 232 columns × 480 courses; dimensions require washed gauge.
Tip-to-tip construction concept: one straight edge, one shaped edge. No KCode exported.
Flat artwork and binary chart previews; fabric texture, stretch and drape are not simulated.
